# mobius-desktop 0.17.7

Configure your own Cloud service and browser sign-in providers through `~/.mobius/cloud.json`, with an optional Apple age gate. Keep API credentials isolated per service and use one exact gateway matcher for the UI and authentication. Existing Cloud users must sign in once again after updating.

Keep Memory under Capabilities in Agent Defaults instead of a separate settings page.

Bundle gateway **0.17.7** with the model catalog updates and managed browser security pins. Protocol **101** is unchanged.
